GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2-3l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, took over approaching 200m and drew clear # had run/too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Inclined to lay in whilst under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Quickly Recovered Settled Down 6th Inside 4 Lengths held-up x 600m had Nowhere To Go Until 300m then couldn't quicken - Race Suited Swoopers this # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages. Had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 6th 5 Lengths 800m 6th 5 Lengths home turn Hooked Out Four Wide 5th Middle Of Track hit lead final 50m to win # back/strong win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in whilst under pressure over the final 100m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, took over approaching 200m and drew clear, soft across the line # bit on these
Jumped Ok sat 9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Taken in on jumping and bumped, then continued to race in restricted room for some distance approaching the 1300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, ran on well # hit line well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported the mare was inclined to lay in for the majority of the event, particularly in the home straight where it proved difficult to fully test.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off all clear, took over 100m and drew clear late # all honours

Jumped Ok Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 2 Lengths off leader/winner 2nd Outside x 800m 1 Lengths , Beaten off @ 400m, Weakened to the line had its chance given had (t/t/1st v/1st) # stalked winner

Bit Slow Out Restrained Straight Out The Back from Outside Settled Down rear 12 Lengths too much to do from there, went wide Turning for home clear run home kept trying without threatening - # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages. Approaching the 300m was bumped on two occasions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained thus Settled Down Off Mid-Field Outside 8 Lengths within 6 Lengths Turning for home in between runners held-up to 00m, x ! # held-up 400-100
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden more conservatively; settled back.
